KnowledgeArticle.Title: Water Main Break
KnowledgeArticle.Description: Report a possible water main break.

Section.Name: Water Main Break Intro
Section.Content:
Need something else?

  • Water Leak on Street or Sidewalk to report a water leak in a public area such as a street or sidewalk
  • Manhole Flooding to report water or sewage coming from an overflowing manhole cover
  • No Water, Low Water Pressure, or Water Temperature Complaint to report no water or low water pressure

A water main break usually involves water flowing up onto the street from below ground and low water pressure in nearby homes and businesses.

What Happens Next

You must provide your contact information so The Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) can contact you, if necessary. DEP cannot action the service request without it.

DEP will respond within 8 hours.
